senses.gloss: pl. m. (Dithpe. or Dispe. of אסר; v. preced.) a binding relation, the relation of a serf or peasant, a sort of tenancy.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 678">Yalk. Lev. 678</cite> <he>דיסטורין</he>) (when consecrating all of his fields) he may still make a living by working as a serf.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 60b:21">Kidd. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>דנקיט בדיסתורא</he> ed. (Ar. <he>דסטורין</he>) when he holds the land shown to her as a peasant (but owns it not).
